visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a beaded bracelet, holds a pink package of "TTL Hua Diao Chicken Dry Noodles" in a kitchen-style studio. He gestures enthusiastically while speaking to the camera. (2) Close-up shots show hands opening various condiment packets—a dark sauce, seasoning powder with green flakes, and a liquid wine packet—and adding them to a bowl of wavy instant noodles. (3) The man mixes the noodles, which are topped with chopped green onions and a fried egg with a runny yolk. He lifts a large bunch of noodles with pink chopsticks, showing the steam and texture. (4) He eats a big bite with an exaggerated expression of satisfaction, followed by a thumbs-up. (5) He introduces a DIY version, holding a blue and white "Wei Lih Men" bowl and a brown glass bottle of Hua Diao wine. He pours wine from a small glass bowl into the noodles. (6) He tastes the DIY noodles, slurping them loudly while tilting his head back with eyes closed in extreme pleasure.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A vibrant male voice greets the audience with high energy, accompanied by a fast-tempo synth-pop BGM. (2) A crisp rustling sound of plastic tearing triggers a shift as the narrator describes the noodle texture. (3) A wet, squelching sound follows as sauce is squeezed out, accompanied by the clatter of a bowl. (4) A splashing sound of liquid is heard clearly as wine is added to the bowl. (5) A loud, moist slurping sound marks the tasting phase, followed by a high-pitched, enthusiastic vocalization of delight. (6) The tone becomes instructional with rhythmic speech as a glass-on-glass pouring sound occurs during the DIY demonstration. (7) A final series of rapid slurping sounds and an exaggerated exclamation of pleasure conclude the track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Experience Review -> Problem/DIY Solution -> Final Verdict
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to review the popular TTL Hua Diao Chicken Dry Noodles and provide a creative DIY solution for those who cannot find the product, using common bowl noodles and bottled wine to replicate the flavor profile. It combines sensory appeal (ASMR slurping) with practical advice.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator prominently features brand logos, names, and package designs of TTL and Wei Lih products throughout the video, acting as a review/demo.
